name: Anemone
description: Offload live transcodes to agent machines. ffmpeg runs on the agent and pushes the HLS segments back over HTTP, so no shared storage is needed for the transcode output.
overview: Distributed live transcoding without shared storage.

versions.changelog: First release. Per-agent hardware translation, media path mapping, per-agent ingest URLs, placement by media locality and measured throughput, and transparent fallback to local transcoding.
